sections.introHtml:
Cooking is my favorite hobby. My grandmother (21) ______ me how to cook my first dish when I was eight. Cuong's blog:

sections.title: II. Read the passage and choose the best answer (A, B, C, or D) for each question. (1,25 points) Do you want to be fitter and healthier? Do you like to look younger? Do you want to feel more relaxed? Then try spending a few days at Helen Manor Health Farm. It is one of the most popular places for a short holiday. Helen Manor is the largest health farm in the country, but it isn't the most expensive. After two days of exercise and massage, you will feel much better. The best thing is the food — it's very healthy and also very tasty!
sections.introHtml: If you want something cheaper, you can try a winter break. Winter is the coldest and darkest time of the year, and it can be bad for your body. We often eat too much and don't do enough exercise. Many health farms offer lower prices from Monday to Friday, between November and March. It's a great way to relax, stay healthy, and enjoy yourself during the winter.

sections.title: III. Write a paragraph (70–80 words) about your school activities last summer. (1,0 point)

questions.html:
You may use the cues below or create your own ideas.

plant trees and flowers

collect rubbish in public places

recycle plastic bottles and cans

donate old books or toys to homeless children

The end
questions.referenceHtml:
You may use the cues below or create your own ideas.

plant trees and flowers

collect rubbish in public places

recycle plastic bottles and cans

donate old books or toys to homeless children

Last summer, I joined many school activities. My classmates and I planted trees and flowers in the school yard. We also collected rubbish in public places to keep the environment clean. We recycled plastic bottles and cans to protect nature. Besides that, we donated old books and toys to homeless children. These activities helped me learn how to care for the environment and share with others. I felt happy and proud to help my community.

The end
